newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran radio slams "Zionist" Reuters for article.
newsitem.headline: Iran radio slams "Zionist" Reuters for article.

text.p: Iranian state radio on Tuesday blasted Reuters as a "Zionist" news agency for a news analysis about Iran's foreign relations, saying the article unjustly portrayed Tehran as isolated on the world scene.
"Indisputably, this long news article by Reuters is proof of disregard for truth and a great effort by this Zionist news agency to deny realities," state-run Tehran radio said.
The radio was commenting on a news analysis by Reuters which quoted analysts and Tehran-based Western diplomats as saying Iran was one of the world's most diplomatically isolated states.
The radio said Iran had active political and economic ties with almost all members of the United Nations, except the United States and Israel.

The Islamic republic had developed "strategic ties" with Russia and China and was actively pursuing bilateral ties with two other permanent members of the Security Council, France and Britain, it added.
Tehran participated effectively in dozens of international organisations and hosted frequent visits by foreign heads of state and senior officials, the radio said.

"The fact that Reuters and some other Western media deny indisputable facts and call Iran isolated is a valuable opportunity allowing people to see the real face of so-called defenders of human rights and freedom," the radio said.
